name: model-workshop-manager
description: Self-hosted inventory for scale modellers: track your kit stash, 10,000+ hobby paints (Tamiya, Vallejo, Citadel…) and builds. Barcode scanning, shopping lists, Docker on amd64/arm64.

paragraphs: Your model kit stash, paint shelf, and builds — self-hosted, on your own hardware.
Website · Quick start · Changelog · Discussions · Report a bug

No more guessing whether you already own that Revell kit, digging through drawers for the right shade of Tamiya paint, or losing track of build progress. Model Workshop Manager keeps your catalog, inventory, and builds in one place — installable as an app on your phone or desktop, and running entirely on your own server.
features: 📦 Stash vs. catalog — a searchable catalog of models and paints, kept separate from what
you actually own (and what's on your wishlist).
🎨 10,000+ paints in one click — the community

miniature-paints dataset, with names, codes, and colors for 30+ brands: Tamiya, Vallejo, Citadel, Mr. Hobby, AK, Mig, Mission Models, Humbrol, Revell, and more. Find it under Import & Export → Import starter catalog.

🔒 Private by default — single-user login, one SQLite file, photos on your own disk.
This is a single-user private app and it requires login — but login raises the bar, it isn't a substitute for not exposing an unaudited personal app to the open internet.
